candidates.title: Cancel a woken victim’s pending report when the reporter is incapacitated again

gdd.quote: Take the reporter down before the call ends and the report is dropped.
A reporter taken down before the report lands drops it.

codeExecutionPath: Game.Step -> TakedownStep -> BodiesStep/Wake -> ReportsStep -> NextLanding -> LandAct -> ChargeAct/Alarm
sim/Suborned.Sim/GameTakedown.cs:804 Wake removes the body and explicitly sets p.Down=false before creating the woken report.
sim/Suborned.Sim/GameTakedown.cs:558 ReportsStep exempts Kind == woken from the reporter Down cancellation guard.
sim/Suborned.Sim/GameTakedown.cs:621 LandAct charges the original assault when the exempt report lands.

existingTests.coverage: Natural wake and report; executed, all 15 checks pass; no second incapacitation.
Stops an ordinary witness before reporting; inspected, not run.
All scenarios feed Passes and adjacent replay/determinism theories.

reproduction.result: N56 15/15 passes. Replaying its orders to wake, then setting the reporter Down before report landing: woken lands at tick 3730 and ActTrail=true; same pending report changed to seen stops and ActTrail=false.
reproduction.limitations: White-box lifecycle reproduction: second incapacitation is an explicit public-state mutation, not a second player order. The control changes Kind. This proves the live cancellation branch discrepancy, not a complete second-takedown route or deterministic replay of the injected mutation.

smallestChange.description: Remove or narrowly correct the woken cancellation exemption now Wake clears Down; add a regression for a victim incapacitated again before a pending report lands. Preserve reports already landed and reports from other witnesses.

dependencies: Existing Wake/ReportsStep machinery and report lifecycle fixtures. No design numbers or model calls required.
acceptanceChecks: Regression: live woken victim reports normally; re-incapacitated victim’s pending report stops, with no original-report Trail or dispatch.
Regression: a second incident and independent witnesses still report normally; reports already landed remain landed.
Run N56 and N65 with Passes and replay/checksum coverage; add an order-driven fixture if practical.
Run focused simulation tests covering report/wake lifecycle; do not claim all broad-suite failures fixed.

confidence.reason: Explicit matching human and agent GDD requirement, current execution path and passing baseline plus failing white-box boundary reproduction.

candidates.title: Prevent a driverless official car from ending the mission as vale-leaves

gdd.quote: The official car needs its driver; without one it waits.
The official car needs its driver: with no driver it waits.

codeExecutionPath: sim/Suborned.Sim/Game.cs:344 CarTimeline gates departure to service lane on !Driver.Down.
sim/Suborned.Sim/Game.cs:362 ValeTimeline considers whether the driver is known down when deciding whether Vale exits.
sim/Suborned.Sim/Game.cs:311 Game.Step at the mission deadline selects rivals-reach-vale or vale-leaves without checking driver availability or whether Vale is in the car.

existingTests.coverage: Normal official-car departure with rivals absent; inspected only.
Vale exits and reaches normal pickup; inspected only.
Driver takedown/report behavior exists; no claim it is unimplemented.

reproduction.result: With rivals delayed to 9999 s, final fight/crowd disabled: Driver.Down=false and Driver.Down=true both end at tick 5100 with Failure/vale-leaves and Vale=Pickup.
reproduction.limitations: Constructed state isolates terminal predicate. Driver.Down is injected without a Body or incident; not a proven reachable capstone route. Actual generated cast may make that route fail earlier.

smallestChange.description: Gate official departure on a usable driver and valid Vale state; retain independent rival and district-seal failures. Add paired available/unavailable driver deadline fixtures.

blockers: Motive/Waymark must resolve the closing-event behavior when the driver is unavailable and rivals are absent: GDD forbids departure but also specifies a mission close; do not silently invent a replacement failure or unlimited mission.
dependencies: A reachable order-driven driver interruption fixture if intended as a capstone route
acceptanceChecks: No vale-leaves when driver is unavailable.
Rivals or seal still fail on their own conditions.
Implement approved no-driver/no-rivals closing behavior with replay checks.

confidence.reason: Predicate mismatch reproduced; gameplay reachability and replacement close behavior need separate proof/ruling.

recommendation.reason: Highest score, explicit rule, bounded current-code bug, no unresolved design decision.

handoff.doneCheck: Regression demonstrates stopped woken report after renewed incapacitation; existing ordinary wake and witness interruption tests plus deterministic replay pass.
